findings.label: Ampho content-column transcription slip (non-blocking, documented)
findings.detail: The task text's Amphotericin B content figures (55.3200 / 54.3650 / 54.6900) disagree with the specified formula (55.30 / 54.35 / 54.70); only the formula-derived values reproduce the authoritative gold ratios (0.1511 / 0.1476 / 0.1500). The implementer documented this in the module and test and asserts the formula-exact values. No action required; noted so a future reviewer does not change the test toward the slipped figures.
